sermon.title: God Judges and Punishes
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this short message Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that God judges and punishes His people when they behave worse than Sodom. He uses Jude 1:7 and Luke 17:28 to show Sodom as an example and argues that the Bible, not science, tells us what is an allegory. He then begins Ezekiel 16, where God lists abominations His people commit, starting with trusting in your own beauty and playing the harlot because of your fame.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor note: the recording ends in the middle of a sentence at about 8:07 (“who would have”), so this page covers only the part he preached on this video. His words in the Luke 17 section blend “the days of Noah/Lot” and “the coming of the Son of Man” (Luke 17:26–30), so Luke 17:28–30 is shown. He gives 1 Chronicles 16:29 as “the beauty of … right living”; the NKJV reads “the beauty of holiness.” He names public figures and religious leaders and makes claims about them, and speaks about homosexuality; those are his words, and they appear only in the transcript, not verified by this site. “[Unclear]” marks one spot (about 7:00) where the captions were not clear. Where he reads Scripture aloud he often uses King James wording.

faqs.answer: He says it is “adultery, sex before marriage, sex in marriage with somebody outside your marriage,” and that incest, orgies, bestiality and homosexuality are also included.
